results.title: Man-Eater
results.overview: Friends go for a camping trip and run into a cannibalistic killer.

results.title: This Tempting Madness
results.overview: After awakening from a coma with no memory and her husband under arrest, an injured woman pieces together her past, only to suspect she may be responsible for the tragedy.

results.title: The Incredible Adventures of Shurik
results.overview: Shurik, like Forrest Gump, will tell the amazing story of his love, traveling through legendary Soviet films and modern memes. He will be helped by Chebubu, a new character, "from childhood, but from 2025" and the king of pop music, Filippino-Kirkorino.

results.title: The Coin
results.overview: Carlo is a bum who suffers from recurrent nightmares. He lives by the rule of the coin, tossing the very same coin over and over again to take every single decision of his life. Coin toss after coin toss, he arrives in L'Aquila, a city hit by an earthquake. Here he becomes involved in a gruesome murder case. With the help of Marta, an alcoholic woman he met on the road, he starts an investigation which will soon have a metaphysical perspective.

results.title: Kaixinling Station
results.overview: A story of "dedication and legacy" among two generations of railway workers at the Happy Ridge Station Signal Crew on the Qinghai-Tibet Railway.

results.title: Rome Underground
results.overview: Featuring the parallel stories of a supersize building project and a jaw-dropping archaeological adventure, Rome Underground takes viewers on an immersive journey deep under the Eternal City — revealing how the construction of a 26-kilometer subway line through Rome has literally unearthed some of the most important discoveries of the modern age.

results.title: Trouble
results.overview: Facing mounting financial troubles, Draven's marriage to Adam teeters on the brink of collapse. When her wealthy former lover, Ceceilius, reenters her life, passions and rivalries ignite, pulling them all into a dangerous game of desire, deception, and unforeseen consequences

results.title: The Raven
results.overview: A man is haunted by an unseen raven.

results.title: Leave One Day
results.overview: Cécile is about to open her own gourmet restaurant, finally making her dream come true, when suddenly her father has a heart attack and she is called back to the village where she was born. Far from the hubbub of Paris life, she runs into her teenage crush. The memories come flooding back, destabilizing her certainties.

results.title: Son of Sara: Volume 1
results.overview: Haunted by strange urges and visions, a pregnant woman past her due date accepts an invitation to dinner where the hosts have a demented interest in the birth of her child.

results.title: Eko
results.overview: In the misty hills of Kaattukunnu, an aging woman and her servant boy struggle to survive the ghosts of the past, as the hunt for Kuriachan — a legendary dog breeder and outlaw — blurs the line between myth, memory, and vengeance, revealing that even in absence, he still rules the hills.

results.title: Deli Meat
results.overview: Two inept criminals, Cammy and Coops, are tasked with burying their first body in the woods but find themselves at loggerheads when they realise that they’ve only brought one spade.

results.title: Emma & Thomas
results.overview: Emma's world is turned upside down when her family move into a new house and welcome a new baby brother. Lost and lonely, Emma can't imagine how her new house will ever feel like home, and doesn't know how to find new friends. That all changes when she meets Thomas, the energetic boy who lives next door with his grandma. Bound by a shared eagerness to explore life, they become the best of friends.

results.title: Stiller
results.overview: James Larkin White is arrested on his arrival at the Swiss border. He is accused of being the missing Swiss sculptor Anatol Stiller. The missing man, with whom he is mistaken, is accused of being involved in the “Smyrnov affair”.

results.title: Mozart: Don Giovanni @ Bavarian State Opera, Munich
results.original_title: Mozart : Don Giovanni Opéra de Munich
results.overview: What if Don Juan were a woman? At the Bayerische Staatsoper in Munich, director David Hermann presents a bold and modernist reinterpretation of Mozart’s opera, elevated by the collective excellence of its cast.

results.title: An Honest Life
results.overview: When a cynical law student in search of inspiration joins a band of anarchists, he becomes entangled in a web of crime where he is more pawn than player.

results.title: Motherland
results.overview: In an alternate present society where the state frees parents from the burden of raising children, a rule enforcer learns a shocking truth that sparks her rebellion.

results.title: Hoshi aux Francofolies de La Rochelle
results.original_title: Hoshi aux Francofolies de La Rochelle

results.title: Gereja Setan
results.overview: Ribka experiences a low point in her life after becoming pregnant out of wedlock and losing her fiancé, Matthew, in a tragic accident. Ribka's parents ask her to hide out of town so that no one else will know about this "shame." Ribka then meets Gladys who gives her a place to stay and introduces her to Hendrik, the leader of the heretical Satanic church. Ribka slowly loses her identity and becomes trapped in horrific dark rituals. The problem becomes even more complicated when Ribka meets Lucifer, who wants to make her "the devil's bride." But amidst her despair, a glimmer of light comes through a spiritual experience that brings her back to true faith.
